verdict.rationale: Fee transparency is a fair question for a law firm, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes rate structures, alternative fee arrangements or billing practices. The Legaltech & ALS page cites AI efficiency gains (20% to 30%) but says nothing about how engagements are priced, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque
